rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server enables LLMs to search, download, and play YouTube music through integration with yt-dlp for video downloading and pygame for audio playback. Built with FastMCP and featuring async operations with progress tracking, it provides tools for YouTube music search, MP3 conversion with FFmpeg, local music library management using TinyDB, and basic playback controls including play and stop functionality. The implementation maintains a persistent database of downloaded tracks with metadata like title, artist, duration, and download date, making it valuable for building AI-powered music discovery and playback systems that can autonomously find, acquire, and organize music collections from YouTube while respecting legal considerations around personal use and copyright compliance.
